title: ECGC Probationary Officer
kicker: Officer posts at India's export credit insurer

value.body: ECGC Ltd is a central government company under the Ministry of Commerce & Industry that insures exporters and banks against the risk of not being paid for exports. It recruits Probationary Officers — mostly in a generalist stream, with a few specialist posts — through its own national notification. Officers work on underwriting, policy servicing, claims and recovery in ECGC's offices.

items.label: Employer
items.note: Formerly Export Credit Guarantee Corporation of India

items.label: Selection stages
items.note: The online test has objective sections and a descriptive English paper

value.title: How you get in
value.body: A bachelor's degree in any discipline for the generalist stream (specialist posts ask for a matching qualification), and the age limit in that year's notice. Apply online when ECGC releases its PO notification, then clear the online test and the interview.

value.title: At a glance
items: Intake is small, and notifications are not released every year.
The syllabus overlaps with bank PO and insurance officer exams, so many candidates prepare for these together.
Officers can be posted to ECGC offices across India.

value.title: ECGC Probationary Officer posts notified
value.note: Posts as advertised; final numbers can change. The 2025 cycle is not shown here.
value.source: ECGC PO recruitment notices, as reported by news sites (NE Now, Scroll, Amar Ujala)
